facts.text: the prom Andie walks into on her own
facts.why: Andie arrives at the prom alone but loses her nerve until she sees Duckie, and they walk into the ballroom arm in arm.
facts.fix: the prom Andie walks into in her homemade dress

vibe.verdict: Duckie's major appliance line, Blane's BMW club and the two-dress cake print, and the neon Trax look suits it, but the dishes are mostly generic.
missing: Andie and Duckie walking into the prom arm in arm
Duckie lip-syncing Try a Little Tenderness (only a footer wink and a cue)
ideas: Swap the 'Prom punch' note for 'Two dresses, one dance'.
Rename 'Blane's turkey and avocado club' to 'Blane's BMW club sandwich'.
Add a Trax record sleeve prop instead of the prom ticket.
Swap 'Prom punch' for 'Pink lemonade punch' so the tagline pays off on the menu.

Andie's pink prom dress made from Iona's dress and the one her dad bought (cake, wink)
